exclusions.source_text: Participants ≥ 18 and ≤ 55 years old will be enrolled.
Pregnant women are excluded from this study because tamoxifen a category D agent with the potential for teratogenic or abortifacient effects.
Prior invasive cancer ≥ T1 (other than non-melanoma skin cancer), unless curatively treated, and all treatment was completed \> 5 years prior to enrollment
exclusions.threshold: treatment completed > 5 years prior to enrollment

exclusions.source_text: Human immunodeficiency virus (HIV)-infected patients are eligible to participate if they are on effective anti-retroviral therapy with undetectable viral load within the prior 6 months
